messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight fail: release 20260510-02 blocked for service=router. Env-parity check: configmap key mismatch + rotated secret absent in PROD

deploy-bot: details:
```
> check: configmap-keys
> envs: staging vs prod
> diff: routing.rules.v2.enabled present in STAGING, absent in PROD
> check: secret-version
> env: prod
> path: secrets/router/tls
> expected_version: v2026-05-09-rot1
> result: NOT_FOUND
```

Nora: I merged the routing rules to staging for canary testing. I thought the secret rotation was already done last night. Looks like prod didn't get the rotated tls secret. :eyes:

Liam: aha. The rotation job failed on prod because the KMS alias change landed after the job ran. I see an error in infra logs: `alias not found` at 2026-05-09T03:21Z.

Priya: Is it safe to hotpatch the secret now? Change window closes in ~15m. If we push the secret without the alias mapped, SSL handshakes could fail for in-flight connections.

Hector: I'd rather not risk a live TLS issue. Recommend pinning the release and rolling back routing.rules.v2 on staging to match prod. Then schedule the secret rotation + alias mapping in the next window.

Nora: Agree rollback. This was meant to be staging-only but somehow the config bundle included the key. I'll open a rollback PR and update the release notes. Command: `./scripts/release pin --service router --tag redwood/router:2026-05-02-stable`

deploy-bot: Action: release 20260510-02 paused by Nora. To resume after manual fixes run `/release unpause 20260510-02` or create a new release with corrected artifacts.

Liam: I'll file INF-7621 to track re-running the rotation with the correct KMS alias and add a preflight hook to verify secret-version presence before release.

Priya: I'll also add a deploycheck for configmap key parity so future merges that change keys require an infra signoff.

Nora: Rollback PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/router/releases/rollbacks/42  includes pinned image and changelog note: "Paused: discovered env parity mismatch (config key + missing rotated TLS secret). Rolled back to stable."

Hector: Good. I'll watch canaries during the revert. If anything flares, I'll escalate to oncall.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by Nora at 2026-05-10T14:12:05Z. Canary checks passing. Prod revert finished at 2026-05-10T14:18:40Z. Release remains paused pending INF-7621 and config parity gating.

Liam: INF-7621 created and assigned. Adding notes: re-run secret rotation, verify KMS alias exists, add deploycheck for `secrets/router/tls` version, and ensure configmap key gating for routing.rules.v2.

Priya: I'll follow up with a small PR to add the parity check: https://github.com/redwood/infra-config/pull/1102. Please review once INF-7621 confirms alias availability.

Nora: Thanks team. Once infra confirms and PRs merge, we'll re-run preflight in staging, then requeue the release. Adding release note draft: "Release paused due to env parity: missing rotated TLS secret in PROD and accidental config key drift. Rolled back to stable image; infra to re-run rotation and add parity checks." :thumbsup:
